ayahs.text: قٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ

tr.sahih: Qāf. By the honored Qur’ān...
tr.pickthall: Qaf. By the Glorious Qur'an,

ayahs.text: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ

tr.sahih: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but they marvel that a warner of their own hath come unto them; and the disbelievers say: This is a strange thing:

ayahs.text: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌ

tr.sahih: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant [i.e., unlikely] return."
tr.pickthall: When we are dead and have become dust (shall we be brought back again)? That would be a far return!

ayahs.text: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَـٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ

tr.sahih: We know what the earth diminishes [i.e., consumes] of them, and with Us is a retaining record.
tr.pickthall: We know that which the earth taketh of them, and with Us is a recording Book.

ayahs.text: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍ مَّرِيجٍ

tr.sahih: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but they have denied the truth when it came unto them, therefor they are now in troubled case.

ayahs.text: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍ

tr.sahih: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?
tr.pickthall: Have they not then observed the sky above them, how We have constructed it and beautified it, and how there are no rifts therein?

ayahs.text: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَـٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍ

tr.sahih: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,
tr.pickthall: And the earth have We spread out, and have flung firm hills therein, and have caused of every lovely kind to grow thereon,

ayahs.text: تَبْصِرَةً وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ

tr.sahih: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allāh].
tr.pickthall: A vision and a reminder for every penitent slave.

ayahs.text: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً مُّبَـٰرَكًا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ

tr.sahih: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest
tr.pickthall: And We send down from the sky blessed water whereby We give growth unto gardens and the grain of crops,

ayahs.text: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَـٰتٍ لَّهَا طَلْعٌ نَّضِيدٌ

tr.sahih: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -
tr.pickthall: And lofty date-palms with ranged clusters,

ayahs.text: رِّزْقًا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ

tr.sahih: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the emergence [i.e., resurrection].
tr.pickthall: Provision (made) for men; and therewith We quicken a dead land. Even so will be the resurrection of the dead.

ayahs.text: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ

tr.sahih: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamūd
tr.pickthall: The folk of Noah denied (the truth) before them, and (so did) the dwellers at Ar-Rass and (the tribe of) Thamud,

ayahs.text: وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍ

tr.sahih: And ʿAad and Pharaoh and the brothers [i.e., people] of Lot
tr.pickthall: And (the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot,

ayahs.text: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ ۚ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ

tr.sahih: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.
tr.pickthall: And the dwellers in the wood, and the folk of Tubb'a: every one denied their messengers, therefor My threat took effect.

ayahs.text: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍ مِّنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ

tr.sahih: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.
tr.pickthall: Were We then worn out by the first creation? Yet they are in doubt about a new creation.

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ

tr.sahih: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein.
tr.pickthall: We verily created man and We know what his soul whispereth to him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.

ayahs.text: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ

tr.sahih: When the two receivers [i.e., recording angels] receive, seated on the right and on the left.
tr.pickthall: When the two Receivers receive (him), seated on the right hand and on the left,

ayahs.text: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ

tr.sahih: He [i.e., man] utters no word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].
tr.pickthall: He uttereth no word but there is with him an observer ready.

ayahs.text: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ

tr.sahih: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
tr.pickthall: And the agony of death cometh in truth. (And it is said unto him): This is that which thou wast wont to shun.

ayahs.text: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ

tr.sahih: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.
tr.pickthall: And the trumpet is blown. This is the threatened Day.

ayahs.text: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ

tr.sahih: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.
tr.pickthall: And every soul cometh, along with it a driver and a witness.

ayahs.text: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ

tr.sahih: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp."
tr.pickthall: (And unto the evil-doer it is said): Thou wast in heedlessness of this. Now We have removed from thee thy covering, and piercing is thy sight this day.

ayahs.text: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَـٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ

tr.sahih: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."
tr.pickthall: And (unto the evil-doer) his comrade saith: This is that which I have ready (as testimony).

ayahs.text: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ

tr.sahih: [Allāh will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,
tr.pickthall: (And it is said): Do ye twain hurl to hell each rebel ingrate,

ayahs.text: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُّرِيبٍ

tr.sahih: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,
tr.pickthall: Hinderer of good, transgressor, doubter,

ayahs.text: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ

tr.sahih: Who made [as equal] with Allāh another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."
tr.pickthall: Who setteth up another god along with Allah. Do ye twain hurl him to the dreadful doom.

ayahs.text: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَـٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ

tr.sahih: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."
tr.pickthall: His comrade saith: Our Lord! I did not cause him to rebel, but he was (himself) far gone in error.

ayahs.text: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ

tr.sahih: [Allāh] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the threat [i.e., warning].
tr.pickthall: He saith: Contend not in My presence, when I had already proffered unto you the warning.

ayahs.text: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّـٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ

tr.sahih: The word [i.e., decree] will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."
tr.pickthall: The sentence that cometh from Me cannot be changed, and I am in no wise a tyrant unto the slaves.

ayahs.text: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍ

tr.sahih: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"
tr.pickthall: On the day when We say unto hell: Art thou filled? and it saith: Can there be more to come?

ayahs.text: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ

tr.sahih: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,
tr.pickthall: And the Garden is brought nigh for those who kept from evil, no longer distant.

ayahs.text: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍ

tr.sahih: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allāh] and keeper [of His covenant].
tr.pickthall: (And it is said): This is that which ye were promised. (It is) for every penitent and heedful one,

ayahs.text: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُّنِيبٍ

tr.sahih: Who feared the Most Merciful in the unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].
tr.pickthall: Who feareth the Beneficent in secret and cometh with a contrite heart.

ayahs.text: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ

tr.sahih: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."
tr.pickthall: Enter it in peace. This is the day of immortality.

ayahs.text: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ

tr.sahih: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.
tr.pickthall: There they have all that they desire, and there is more with Us.

ayahs.text: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ

tr.sahih: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?
tr.pickthall: And how many a generation We destroyed before them, who were mightier than these in prowess so that they overran the lands! Had they any place of refuge (when the judgment came)?

ayahs.text: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ

tr.sahih: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].
tr.pickthall: Lo! therein verily is a reminder for him who hath a heart, or giveth ear with full intelligence.

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ

tr.sahih: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.
tr.pickthall: And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in six Days, and naught of weariness touched Us.

ayahs.text: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ

tr.sahih: So be patient, [O Muḥammad], over what they say and exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,
tr.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad) bear with what they say, and hymn the praise of thy Lord before the rising and before the setting of the sun;

ayahs.text: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَـٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ

tr.sahih: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration [i.e., prayer].
tr.pickthall: And in the night-time hymn His praise, and after the (prescribed) prostrations.

ayahs.text: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ

tr.sahih: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -
tr.pickthall: And listen on the day when the crier crieth from a near place,

ayahs.text: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ

tr.sahih: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].
tr.pickthall: The day when they will hear the (Awful) Cry in truth. That is the day of coming forth (from the graves).

ayahs.text: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ

tr.sahih: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination
tr.pickthall: Lo! We it is Who quicken and give death, and unto Us is the journeying.

ayahs.text: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ

tr.sahih: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.
tr.pickthall: On the day when the earth splitteth asunder from them, hastening forth (they come). That is a gathering easy for Us (to make).

ayahs.text: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ

tr.sahih: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur’ān whoever fears My threat.
tr.pickthall: We are Best Aware of what they say, and thou (O Muhammad) art in no wise a compeller over them. But warn by the Qur'an him who feareth My threat.
